user.title: Connect to Hydros
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant connects to your HYDROS system.

api.title: HYDROS Public API
api.description:
Enter a provider key and a device key.

1. Request your own provider key at coralvuehydros.com/api (use the "unlisted" option for personal/scripted access).
2. In the HYDROS app, create a device key for the device you want to expose. Choose "Read & write" if you want remote control, or "Read only" for monitoring.

One device key = one device, so add the integration again for each additional controller.

{error_detail}

legacy.title: HYDROS account login (deprecated)
legacy.description:
Enter the email and password used for the HYDROS web portal.

This path relies on HYDROS' consumer backend and is expected to stop working as devices move to the official API. New installs should use the official HYDROS API instead.

collectives.title: Select collectives
collectives.description: Choose one or more collectives to expose in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate HYDROS
reauth_confirm.description: The stored HYDROS keys were rejected. Enter a current provider key and device key.

error.invalid_auth: The provider key or device key was rejected. Check both keys, and confirm CoralVue has activated your provider key.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the HYDROS API. Check this machine's internet connection and try again.
error.server_error: The HYDROS API returned an error. This often means the provider key is not active yet — check with CoralVue. Details are shown above and in the logs.

abort.no_collectives: No collectives available for this account.
abort.already_configured: This HYDROS device is already set up.

init.title: Remote control and Alexa
init.description: Turn on remote control to change modes, outlets and pumps from Home Assistant. The Alexa scene settings below are optional — leave any field blank if you don't use it.

data_description.alexa_easy_setup: Uses the default Feed and Maintenance scenes and ignores the scene settings below.

feed_scene.name: Feed scene
feed_scene.description: Optional. Used only when Alexa scenes are on and easy setup is off.

maintenance_scene.name: Maintenance scene
maintenance_scene.description: Optional. Used only when Alexa scenes are on and easy setup is off.

custom_scene.name: Custom scene
custom_scene.description: Optional. Leave blank if you don't need a third scene.

disclaimer.title: Safety disclaimer
disclaimer.description:
⚠️ Always use the Hydros native application for critical control.

Network outages, cloud/API changes, software defects, and misconfiguration (such as a problematic automation) can cause unsafe behavior. The native application has built-in safeguards that this integration cannot replicate.

Set timeouts on all your Hydros modes (in the mode configuration within the Hydros app) so the default mode is restored automatically if a command is missed.

By enabling remote control, you acknowledge these risks and accept full responsibility.
